q: Question 1 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 Find the number of rectangles and squares in an 8 by 8 chess board respectively. Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 55 Correct% 17 Your time 8 Avg time 144 Chess board consists of 9 horizontal 9 vertical lines. A rectangle can be formed by any two horizontal and two vertical lines. Number of rectangles = 9C2 × 9C2 = 1296. For squares there is one 8 by 8 square four 7 by 7 squares, nine 6 by 6 squares and like this Number of squares on chess board = 12+22…..82 = 204 Only rectangles = 1296-204 = 1092.

Question 10 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 A man invested x rupees for 17 years at a rate of 33% simple interest. Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 57 Correct% 42 Your time 6 Avg time 136 The amount he received after 17 years = the amount he invested + the interest he received on the amount he invested = x + x * 17 * 33 / 100 = x + 5.61x = 6.61x = 45,00,088 rupees 6.61x = 45,00,088 rupees, x = 45,00,088 / 6.61 = 6,80,800 rupees.

Question 13 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 There are 20 points in a plane, how many triangles can be formed by these points if 5 are colinear? Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 43 Correct% 21 Your time 6 Avg time 73 Number of points in plane n = 20. Number of colinear points m = 5. Number of triangles from by joining n points of which m are colinear = nC3 – mC3 Therefore the number of triangles = 20C3 – 5C3 = 1140-10 = 1130.
